comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: The implementation confirms the case-sensitive lookup: `recordConsumedAuth()` stores names verbatim, while `redactedHeaders()` checks each recorded name directly with `name in headers`. A minimal fix is to compare normalized lowercase names while assigning `REDACTED` to the original key, so the returned header casing stays unchanged. A regression test should cover `recordConsumedAuth(req, ["Authorization"])` against `{ authorization: "secret" }` (and the reverse casing if non-Node request objects are supported).
